description.value: Shanghai Fortune Cuisine is a Shanghainese fast-food spot located inside a mall on the Kingsway corridor in Burnaby, offering an online-order pickup service. The menu centres on Shanghai specialties — pan-fried pork buns (sheng jian bao), soup dumplings (xiao long bao), noodle soups, and rice-cake dishes — alongside a short dim-sum selection. Cyclists riding the Kingsway route have a range of hot, filling options available for quick pickup.
